sources.snippet: Gemma 4 E2B IT — Abliterated This is an abliterated (uncensored) version of google/gemma 4 E2B it, created using Abliterix. E2B is the Effective 2B member of Google's Gemma 4 family — a multimodal (text + vision + audio) model with ~5.1B raw parameters.

sources.title: Gemma 4 E2B It Abliterated | Sweet Tea Studio
sources.snippet: E2B is the member of Google's Gemma 4 family — a multimodal (text + vision + audio) model with ~5.1B raw parameters. Despite being one of the smallest Gemma 4 variants, its decoder shares the same double-norm + Per-Layer Embeddings (PLE) architecture that makes Gemma 4 famously resistant to LoRA-based abliteration.
